== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|A Hive is a massive, organic-mechanical structure composed of integrated flesh and Iron{{!}}iron. These entities can function as independent, animalistic organisms that hunt for resources when not coordinated by an [[Iron King]], or they can be utilized as strategic assets. They are heavily defended by various combat units, including scout-ships, drones, and weapons platforms, and the structures themselves possess living walls. Within a Hive, various entities such as [[Pawns]], Shepherds, and [[Reavers]] can pose significant threats to intruders. Some [[Hives]] are governed by a Bishop of the Iron Legion{{!}}Bishop, which is an awakened consciousness that controls the structure for specific purposes. While many [[Hives]] appear as disorganized masses of metal and biological matter, the [[Grand Hive]] is a unique, planet-sized entity shaped like a skull that serves as a [[fortress]]. The [[Grand Hive]] is notable for being hollowed out, with its core components removed, and it is associated with the last [[Iron King]] to mature. On a larger [[scale]], [[Hives]] can be positioned by factions like the [[Galactic Union]] to form strategic formations, such as a spear-like shaft, to facilitate deep galactic thrusts.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The Hive is a unit utilized by the [[Iron Legion]] that originated as an [[Iron Legion]] [[ritual room]]. This structure suffered significant damage when a [[ritual]] was disrupted, leading to its [[destruction]]. Within the center of a Hive, the Bishop of the Iron Legion{{!}}Bishop is located. While characters have entered a Hive that projects standard starship shields, Sola Kalter{{!}}Sola may have witnessed certain things while inside one.}}
